instruction: Switch the folder pane view to show only favorite folders in Thunderbird.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent navigated hamburger menu to View > Folders and saw Unified Folders option. Incorrectly assumed it was grayed out and needed multiple accounts. Spent remaining turns trying to add a fake email account (test.user@example.com) which failed. Never actually clicked on Unified Folders.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Thunderbird hamburger menu, access View > Folders submenu, open Account Settings, fill form fields, interact with tabs
metadata.failure_analysis: Model misinterpreted the Unified Folders option as grayed out/unavailable. Instead of clicking it, spent all turns on an irrelevant workaround (adding a fake email account). The core issue was incorrect assumption about UI state.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to switching folder view to Favorite Folders via the same menu path (View > Folders). This is an achievable sub-task within the model's demonstrated menu navigation capability.
metadata.explanation: Task requires switching folder pane to Favorite Folders view via hamburger menu > View > Folders > Favorite Folders. Evaluator checks xulstore.json for folderTree mode containing 'favorite', same pattern as original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads xulstore.json from the Thunderbird profile, which is where Thunderbird persists UI state including folder pane view mode.
Metric check_json correctly navigates the JSON key path ['chrome://messenger/content/messenger.xhtml', 'folderTree', 'mode'] to find the folder tree view mode setting.
Regex '\bfavorite\b' correctly matches the 'favorite' folder view mode value that Thunderbird stores when Favorite Folders view is selected.
Postconfig correctly closes Thunderbird before reading the file, ensuring xulstore.json is written to disk with the latest UI state.
Single-step instruction with complete verification coverage - the folder pane view mode is fully checked.
Parameter flow is correct: get_vm_file returns a file path string, check_json receives it as the result parameter, and the rules dict is passed directly as the second parameter.

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
